title: Settings
subtitle: API keys, data export and import, sharing, and paper recurring buys. Paper trading is not real money.

keys.hint: Named keys bind to this desk. The secret is shown once. Read keys cannot trade; trade keys can place paper orders.
keys.name: Name
keys.created: Copy this secret now — it will not be shown again.

export.hint: Download your watchlist, shares, alerts, scanner backtests, paper books (baskets, rebalance history, and risk limits), and custom signal mixes as JSON or CSV.

import.hint: Restore a previous export, including paper-book baskets, rebalance history, and risk limits. Preview first so you can see which custom signal mixes will be added as new and which will update a saved mix.
import.stalePreview: Saved mixes changed after this preview. Preview the file again before importing.
import.profilesConflict: Name conflicts — pick which saved mix to update
import.conflictHint: More than one mix uses this name. Choose a target, or leave it unselected to skip.

recurring.hint: Paper market buys on a schedule. Insufficient cash fails that run only. Not real money.
